item.title: Chipperfield presents new Nobel Center design with reclaimed bricks in Stockholm
item.description: The latest design for David Chipperfield Architects’ Nobel Center in Stockholm has been revealed. An earlier proposal by Chipperfield's team was selected as the winner of an international competition in 2014; however, the design and scale for the original site faced public pushback and were ultimately blocked by the courts in 2018. item.title: ZOLAND·Emei, Studio J. Bridgland by Studio J. Bridgland
item.description: ZOLAND·Emei Resort is a boutique mountain retreat in Emeishan, designed by Studio J. Bridgland(SJB). Rooted in the philosophy of architectural quietude, the project transforms a series of dilapidated structures into a sanctuary that dissolves seamlessly into the forested landscape—inviting guests to reconnect with nature and with themselves. item.title: Drunk N' Jump Hong Kong by R-BAS
item.description: Amidst the clamour of SoHo’s thoroughfare in Central — a quarter celebrated for its vibrant nocturnal economy — the Hong Kong debut of Drunk N' Jump (TIAOHAI) settles on Wellington Street. item.title: BIG London employees hold protest over redundancy plans
item.description: Workers from Bjarke Ingels Group’s London office held a protest outside their office yesterday over the studio’s redundancy plans. A union group claims that in December the firm announced that approximately 140 jobs were at risk due to the loss of a major project, though the UK-based Architect’s Journal reported this week that 72 roles are at risk. item.title: IAAC students build a compact Pyrenees cabin with local timber by IaaC - The Institute for Advanced Architecture of Catalonia
item.description: Forestone Cabin is a 20 m² experimental wooden dwelling designed and built by the 2025 cohort of IAAC’s Master in Ecological Architecture and Advanced Construction, as part of the Bio for Piri initiative. Led by the Fundació Catalunya La Pedrera and funded by the Biodiversity Foundation with European Next Generation funds, this initiative promotes regenerative forestry and the sustainable use of local timber from Pyrenean forests, specifically in Alinyà (Lleida).
